name: fabrik
description: Ambient awareness of Fabrik (the GitHub-Project-driven SDLC pipeline orchestrator) for the human's interactive Claude Code session. Turns Claude into a product-management buddy and supervisor for projects that use Fabrik to automate issue processing.

subscriber.title: Subscriber name
subscriber.description: Stable name this session attaches to the Fabrik daemon under (your topic or session name, never a PID). Needed for the overseer actions (they sign their audit comment with it) and for pushed channel events. Leave empty for read-only use.

fabrik_dir.title: Fabrik directory
fabrik_dir.description: Directory of the Fabrik daemon to talk to. Leave empty to use the daemon of the directory your Claude Code session is in.
